findings.evidence: TauCeti/Topology/Category/TopPair.lean:261 `def ofInclusionIsoOfSubset (ht : ∀ x, x ∈ t) {s₀ : Set X} (hs : ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ s₀) : ofInclusion hst ≅ ofSubset s₀`, with `hom` the subtype value: the same map as `interHom`/`univHom`. It is already used for the univ, univ ∩ univ and univ ∪ univ pairs at Cohomology/MayerVietoris/Pair.lean:715-721. `subspaceComplPair q W` is `TopPair.ofSubset (q ⁻¹' (W : Set F)ᶜ)` (Singular/MayerVietoris/SubspaceCompl.lean:55).
findings.fix: Delete the six declarations and use `interIso := TopPair.ofInclusionIsoOfSubset _ (fun _ ↦ ⟨trivial, trivial⟩) (mem_half_inter_half_iff q s)`, `unionIso := (TopPair.ofInclusionIsoOfSubset _ (fun _ ↦ Or.inl trivial) fun x ↦ (mem_half_union_half_iff q s x).trans Iff.rfl).symm` and `univIso A := TopPair.ofInclusionIsoOfSubset _ Set.mem_univ fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl`. `interIso_hom_fst` then follows from `ofInclusionIsoOfSubset_hom_fst_apply`, and the `hinter`/`hunion` squares follow from `ofInclusionMap_inclusion_comp_ofInclusionIsoOfSubset_hom`, as in `exists_singularCohomologyComplRestrict_eq_of_add_eq_zero`.
